verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents a first-party AppSec Platform API, but the documented scope covers only listing deployments, gathering findings and listing projects. That is mostly read-oriented access rather than full programmatic control of the product, and the OpenAPI probe found no machine-readable spec at the common docs paths. missing for 10: documented write/control endpoints (e.g., triggering scans, triaging findings, managing rules/policies via API), a published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, auth/usage detail in evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Semgrep AppSec Platform provides an API that enables you to list deployments, gather findings created by Semgrep AppSec Platform, and list projects.
